item.description:
Conversations and files, all in one place

  • Opening an email loads its conversation in the same reading pane. Expand other messages and reply to each one while keeping separate drafts.
  • Preview PDFs, images and text attachments inside the email. Save remains available for files you want to keep or open elsewhere.
  • ⌘Delete now targets the email under your cursor, falling back to the selected email outside the list. The five-second Undo remains.

Attachment previews are limited to supported formats and files up to 25 MiB. Cloud sync remains optional; mobile access and push notifications are not available yet.

Smoother scrolling and synced reminders

  • Older mail loads automatically when you reach the end of the list, with an inline retry if loading fails.
  • With the optional cloud pilot enabled, snooze times sync to Cove independently of the recent-mail copy, including reminders for older emails.
  • Offline snooze changes, rescheduling and cancellations are saved and retried safely. The snooze menu shows whether a reminder is local, pending or synced.
  • Tomorrow morning now means the following calendar day at 9 a.m. in your local time zone.

Cloud sync remains off by default. Mobile access and push notifications are not available yet; snoozed mail returns in Cove when due while the app is open, or when you reopen it.

A clearer email reader

  • More thoughtful spacing, labeled toolbar actions, and clearer sender details.
  • Jev’s assessment and source excerpts sit apart from the original email.
  • Reply, Forward, and Ask Cove stay within reach as you scroll.
  • Choose Formatted or Text only, flag an email for follow-up, set a local reminder, or prepare a translation request in Ask Cove.
  • Controls and long sender details adapt to narrow reading panes.
